The '''Cilgris family''' were a family of [[Duros/Legends|Duros]] [[Merchant/Legends|traders]]. Members of the family outwardly claimed to be interested in earning profits, rather than aiding good causes, but they were all sympathetic to individuals fighting to attain liberty and justice. The family owned and operated the [[Barloz-class medium freighter|''Barloz''-class freighter]] ''[[Birthright]]''; the [[Starship/Legends|ship]] was purchased by [[Thes Cilgris]] during the waning [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and by the time of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], it was being run by Thes' son, [[Yett Cilgris]]. Around the time of the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]], Thes' nephew [[Naul Cilgris]] had became the [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] of the ''Birthright''.
